sanskrit_verse:
पित्र्यमेवाग्रतो देयं पश्चादात्मीयमेव च ।
तयोः पैतामहं पूर्वं देयमेवमृणं सदा ॥
transliteration: pitryam evāgrato deyaṃ paścād ātmīyam eva ca / tayoḥ paitāmahaṃ pūrvaṃ deyam evam ṛṇaṃ sadā //
sph_interpretive_translation: The debt to the father must be discharged before all else; after that, the duty to oneself. Between these two, the grandfather's obligation comes first. Thus, the order of duty is always clear.
jurisprudential_principles: Capacity-based responsibility originates in familial continuity
Consciousness alignment requires honoring antecedent obligations
executable_legal_axioms: IF a person has unmet paternal obligations AND personal claims pending THEN discharge paternal obligations FIRST
IF a claim involves both parental and grandparental duties THEN prioritize grandparental duties as precedent-establishing
IF self-interest conflicts with filial duty THEN filial duty overrides self-interest until completion
IF generational debts are unresolved THEN individual autonomy remains legally subordinate
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating matters involving inheritance, guardianship, or family resource allocation, the Supreme Court shall recognize the primacy of ancestral obligations over individual entitlements. Legal standing derived from neglecting prior-generation duties shall be nullified until such duties are executed.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Ṛṇa (debt) is established through pramāṇa of birth-linked continuity, where anupūrvaśaḥ determines the sequence of fulfillment. Responsibility arises not as fault but as sequential capacity activation. No punitive consequence attaches to delay; however, dharma-vyavastha remains unbalanced until completion occurs.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate ancestral remembrance process to awaken debtor consciousness
Assign facilitator to guide ritual and material restitution procedures
Realign debtor’s financial and temporal capacities toward immediate fulfillment
Integrate family council to validate completion and restore relational integrity
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this ruling establishes that ancestral obligations precede individual rights. Dharma is restored when generational continuity is honored. Reality is non-punitive; consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
